title: Earth's orbit from public data: HARPS-N solar radial velocity 2015-2018, tau Ceti (HARPS RVBank), SDO/HMI apparent solar radius 2023

radius_enters_via.how: rebuilt as RV - BERV: the barycentric correction added back is computed from ephemerides, with the Earth's radius
the apparent radius is computed by the SDO pipeline from the spacecraft-Sun distance, an ephemeris

verdict_rule: Doppler residuals at the level of the instrument, about 1 m/s, for some height of the flat model's Sun; a zenith star that stays put through the year to better than a second of arc.
license_note: DACE (Univ. Geneva) HARPS-N solar release: public, cite Dumusque et al. 2021; VizieR J/A+A/636/A74 (Trifonov et al. 2020); SDO/HMI data courtesy of NASA/SDO and the HMI science team (JSOC), public.

sources.cite: Dumusque et al. 2021, HARPS-N solar telescope, first public release 2015-2018 (DACE)
Trifonov et al. 2020, HARPS RVBank, VizieR J/A+A/636/A74 (HD 10700, tau Ceti)

units.SUN_DAYS: t0 UTC; pts [s since t0, m/s] (rv_raw - berv)
units.TAU_CETI: [BJD, m/s], one mean per night (RVdrs - BERV)

inputs.origin: VizieR J/A+A/636/A74 (HARPS RVBank, Trifonov et al. 2020), tau Ceti, the request in the URL.
inputs.public_raw_why: CDS/VizieR distributes it free for scientific use with citation; its terms do not say that a copy may be republished, so only the hash and the request are given.

inputs.origin: JSOC, hmi.Ic_720s keyword RSUN_OBS, 2023 weekly, the request in the URL.

notes: One dataset, three sources: the class is the most cautious of the three (check). The parallax and aberration sections that are measures use star catalogues, not these files.
